Power|+20}} }} The '''Steel Falchion''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|9000}} after reaching floor 90 in [[The Mines]]. It can also be obtained as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item drop]] on Floors 100-119 of [[The Mines]], in the [[Skull Cavern]], or in the [[Quarry Mine]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 110 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Damage changed from 26-38 to 28-46.
